\caption{\bt{\system\ architecture. One agent explores, and its verified session is published after the publication checks (1--2). Every other agent receives the shared definition and answers with one SQL (3); it declares the definition's version, and \system\ runs the query on one snapshot on which the version's conditions hold (4--5). When updates change a table (6), maintenance reads the table versions, reuses the shared check results, and repairs or optimizes each definition once for all agents (7--8). Thick arrows write the shared memory; dashed arrows read database state.}{\system\ 架构。一个智能体探索，其核对正确的会话经发布前检查后发布（1--2）。其他每个智能体拿到共享的定义，用一条 SQL 作答（3）；它声明定义的版本，\system\ 在该版本前提成立的同一快照上执行查询（4--5）。数据更新改变某张表时（6），维护读取表版本、复用共享的检查结果，并为所有智能体对每个定义只修复或优化一次（7--8）。粗箭头写入共享记忆，虚线箭头读取数据库状态。}}
\label{fig:architecture}
\Description{Top: four agent windows. Agent A, under the tag "explores once", asks for store revenue in March with the definition given, uses table, search, join, and SQL tools, and its answer is verified. Agents B, C, and D, under the tag "every other agent reuses", ask about September, the best month, and Q3 against Q2; each window holds the same card "Store revenue v2" and answers with one SQL. Middle: the MAVRA panel with four modules: Publish (a shield; answer matches, SQL replays, key unique), Shared memory (definition cards Store revenue v2 valid, Return rate v1 valid, Catalog sales v1 checking, and a strip of shared check results), Maintain (repair and optimize, once for all), and Run (a camera; on one snapshot, version valid, conditions hold). Bottom: the SQL database with the tables store\_sales, date\_dim, item, store, and customer, and a stack of updates feeding it. Numbered arrows: 1--2 publish in violet, 3--5 use in amber, 6--8 maintain and optimize in blue.}
\end{figure*}
